name: Youth Volunteer Program: Summer of Service
city: Roanoke, Christiansburg, Rocky Mount and Lexington, VA
what_you_do: Volunteer at a Carilion hospital for 6 to 8 summer weeks. You work alongside staff and adult volunteers, explore health care careers, and build confidence and social skills.
deadline_text: For 2026, Carilion held a virtual information session on Tuesday, February 24, 2026 and posted a 2026 application. 2027 dates are not posted; expect a late winter start.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Summer of Service application linked on the Volunteer Services page when it is posted. If you missed the information session, email the Volunteer Services Manager at your hospital.
notes: Hospitals: Carilion Roanoke Memorial, Carilion Franklin Memorial (Rocky Mount), Carilion New River Valley Medical Center (Christiansburg) and Carilion Rockbridge Community Hospital (Lexington). Contacts: Roanoke, tnmedley@carilionclinic.org; New River Valley, plmemitt@carilionclinic.org; Lexington, snclemmer@carilionclinic.org; Rocky Mount, rdaltice@carilionclinic.org.
